title: INTO OSU ACADEMIC LISTENING AND SPEAKING 5
description: Skill building to develop and improve comprehension and notetaking of lectures in an academic format. Students required to give individual and group presentations including informational, argumentative, and persuasive presentations. Instruction is given in cross-cultural communications styles, non-verbal communication, questioning techniques, and clarifying information.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment is limited to INTO OSU GE/AE/Pathways level students.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
meeting_html: MWF 2pm-3:50pm in ILLC 350/352 - International Living Learning 350/352 (9/23 to 12/4)
